root_cause: Torch-compiled execution itself left negative memory for cache blocks even with XPU graph capture disabled; vLLM refused to start.
interpretation: The 0.24 GiB improvement over R20 is explained by the higher 0.968 memory budget. Disabling graph capture did not recover the roughly 2 GiB compile-versus-eager residency gap.
closure: Official block-FP8 TP1 with FP16-family KV is closed on one B70 for this runtime: eager fits at 49.622256 tok/s c32, while both compiled profiles cannot allocate KV cache. No dual-replica rate may be inferred.
